data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.9m (2017: deficit of GBP 5.2m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

named_events.loss_description: Result mainly attributable to a significant loss-making scheme (Foresight).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 opened 2018 with gross long-term/claims provisions of approximately GBP 21.0m. During 2018 there was favourable prior-year development, with a reported net surplus of GBP 3.9m relating to reassessment of previous accident years; this is treated here as a release. The managing agent attributes improvement in prior years to favourable experience on the Foresight business and an improvement in back year reserves. No large named catastrophe events affecting these reserves were identified in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.9m (2017: deficit of GBP 5.2m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
the two main factors being favourable experience on the Foresight business, combined with a GBP 1.6m improvement in back year reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Long-term business provision 'At 1 January' (note) as gross surrogate for claims outstanding for a long-term life syndicate. Prior-year development: only a NET prior-year surplus (GBP 3.9m) is explicitly stated in the technical result note; no explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure printed. Therefore net figure used as a last-resort per rules and flagged accordingly. Gross claims development triangle exists and was cross-checked but the report does not present a clear single-line gross 'movement in prior years' amount; triangle present but RITC and run-off effects may distort comparability. Reinsurance acceptances in the segmental note are printed as a negative figure (as per the note) and are included here to reconcile to total gross written premium.
